_about: Every text CRANE-LLM shows to users, for both the JupyterLab extension and the %%crane_llm magic. Words in {braces} are filled in at runtime; keep them. After editing: run reload_crane_llm() in a notebook for the magic and the backend, and `jlpm build` in crane_llm/nb_extension, then refresh the browser, for JupyterLab.

toolbar.label: CRANE-LLM
toolbar.tooltip: Predict whether the selected cell will crash

commands.run_caption: Build the CRANE prompt from the active notebook cell and run the LLM
commands.toggle_caption: Include the live kernel state in the prompt. When off, only the executed cells and the target cell are sent.
commands.toggle_llm_caption: Ask the LLM when the built-in checker finds no crash. When off, only the built-in checker runs and nothing is sent.

runinfo.label: Include runtime information
runinfo.hint_on: Prompt: executed cells, runtime state, target cell.
runinfo.hint_off: Prompt: executed cells and target cell only.
runinfo.hint_llm_off: Only used when the LLM is on.

llm.label: Use the LLM
llm.hint_on: The LLM is asked when the built-in checker finds no crash.
llm.hint_off: Only the built-in checker runs. Nothing is sent to an LLM.

sidebar.title: CRANE-LLM
sidebar.caption: CRANE-LLM prompt and response
sidebar.status_check_done: done: built-in check, no LLM call
sidebar.status_check_only_done: done: built-in checker only, LLM off
sidebar.no_prompt_llm_off: No prompt was sent. The LLM is switched off, so only the built-in checker ran.
sidebar.no_prompt_check: The built-in checker found a crash, so the LLM was not called.
sidebar.status_busy: not run: the notebook is busy

progress.no_finding: Built-in checker: no crash found. Asking the LLM...

verdict.title: CRANE-LLM: {label}
verdict.label_no_finding: no crash found by the checker
verdict.note_check: Crash found by CRANE-LLM's built-in checker, without calling the LLM. The cell will raise when it runs.
verdict.note_model_after_check: Predicted by the LLM. This is a prediction, and it can be wrong.
verdict.note_check_only: The built-in checker found no crash,  no LLM prediction was made. The cell may still crash: the checker only reports crashes it is certain of.
verdict.note_model_code_only: Predicted by the LLM from the code alone. This is a prediction, and it can be wrong.
verdict.stale_explanation: A cell has run since this check, so the kernel state it was based on may have changed. Run the check again for a current prediction.

origins.heading: Origin of the crash
origins.summary_undefined_one: `{variable}` is not defined. It is assigned in a cell of this notebook that did not define it in this session.
origins.summary_undefined_many: `{variable}` is not defined. It is assigned in {count} cells of this notebook that did not define it in this session.
origins.cell_missing: a cell no longer in this notebook
origins.cell_note: CRANE-LLM: this cell {action} `{variable}`, behind the crash in {target}.
origins.cell_note_line: CRANE-LLM: this cell {action} `{variable}` (line {line}), behind the crash in {target}.

notes.not_run: has not run in this kernel session
notes.edited: has been edited since it ran
notes.ran_no_define: ran, but did not define it
notes.partial_run: this run raised an error partway
notes.code_only: read from the code; ran before tracking started

checker.feature_count: `{data}` has {columns} columns but `{model}` was fitted on {expected}.

errors.no_kernel: No kernel is connected to this notebook. Start the kernel first.
errors.kernel_dead: The kernel is not running. Restart it first.
errors.kernel_restarting: The kernel is restarting. Wait for it to come back, then try again.
errors.notebook_busy: CRANE-LLM cannot run while the notebook is executing. Wait for the running cells to finish, then try again.
errors.kernel_timeout: The kernel did not respond within {seconds}s. It may still be busy running another cell.
errors.no_payload:
The kernel did not return a CRANE-LLM payload. Output was:
{output}
errors.unknown_error: The kernel reported an unknown error.
